channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: French Expression of The Day: Qui dort, dîne
item.description: This French expression goes back to Medieval times and addresses the fundamentals of life.

item.title: French Grammar Tip: Why does French have so many silent letters?
item.description: The French language is somewhat averse to pronouncing every letter in a word, especially the final one - here's a guide to how silent letters work, and which letters to pronounce.

item.title: Which French figure has the most streets named after them?
item.description: In French town after French town, you’ll see famous names from history honoured on street signs - but who wins the prize for the biggest number of streets, avenues and boulevards bearing their name?

item.title: Fears grow for French loans at Louvre Abu Dhabi as war rages
item.description: The escalating Middle East war has raised concerns over the safety of masterpieces on loan from France to the Louvre Abu Dhabi, sparking questions about the security of the famed museum's only foreign branch.

item.title: Air France-KLM hikes long-haul ticket prices
item.description: Air France-KLM said Thursday it is raising long-haul ticket prices due to soaring jet fuel prices caused by the the Iran war.

item.title: Why does north-east France have different laws and more holidays?
item.description: The north-east France area of Alsace-Lorraine has a special exemption to a number of French laws, as well as having more public holidays per year - here's why.

item.title: Allergy season: What to ask for in French pharmacies
item.description: Allergy season is upon us in France - cue the endless sneezing coupled with red and itchy eyes. Here's what you can ask for at the pharmacy to help you fight off the pollen.

item.title: How to make the most of May in France
item.description: Yes, we know it's only March - but part of the secret of truly making the most of the month of May is forward planning.

item.title: La Belle Vie: French bakeries without baguettes and sleeping on trains
item.description: From the French obsession with food to loving Airbnbs and booking your upcoming holidays - this week’s La Belle Vie newsletter offers an essential starting point for eating, talking, drinking, and living like a local.

item.title: French oil giant caps petrol prices at €1.99 'until the end of March'
item.description: Following a meeting with the government, France's biggest oil company has announced a new price cap at fuel pumps through to the end of March.
